headline: Premier League live updates: Chelsea lead Arsenal through Rogers volley
description: We have more matches across Europe this Sunday, with Arsenal hosting Chelsea in a clash of attack vs. defense.

headline: Last-gasp Ainsley Maitland-Niles screamer snatches point for Everton against Man United
description: Ainsley Maitland-Niles scored a dream stoppage-time equaliser on his Everton debut to earn a 2-2 draw against Manchester United and lift the mood at the end of a difficult week.

headline: Tottenham boss Roberto De Zerbi says Mykhailo Mudryk will need time to find his best form
description: Tottenham boss Roberto De Zerbi has said Mykhailo Mudryk will need time to show his best after making his first appearance in almost two years.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool eye Ismaïla Sarr move in January
description: The transfer window may be over, but that hasn't stopped clubs from doing business. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: City squeeze past Coventry behind Haaland's winner
description: Erling Haaland's first-half header sees Manchester City edge out Coventry 1-0 to make it three wins from three to start their Premier League campaign.

headline: Mikel Arteta confident that Bukayo Saka can take his game to 'different level' at Arsenal
description: Mikel Arteta has praised Bukayo Saka's determination to take his game to a new level during Arsenal's Premier League title defence.
